target.name: Above-regional food-price pressure
target.definition: HIGH when the province's food-CPI year-on-year inflation is above the five-province CALABARZON average for the quarter.
target.caveat: A forecast of relative food-price pressure, one component of the study's food-stress label. It is not a measured food-insecurity outcome: no repeated provincial food-insecurity measure exists for 2020-2025.

feature_labels.D_t: Food inflation gap vs. CALABARZON average (latest)
feature_labels.D_tm1: Food inflation gap vs. CALABARZON average (previous)
feature_labels.dF_t: Change in food inflation (quarter on quarter)
feature_labels.rice_qoq_t: Regular-milled rice price change (quarter on quarter)
feature_labels.unemp_tm1: Unemployment rate (regional series, one quarter back)

meta.unemployment_note: unemployment_rate is one regional series repeated for all provinces.
meta.publication_rule: Amendment 1: a lead is published only if the served model's walk-forward ROC-AUC 95% lower bound is above 0.5.
meta.information_cutoff_reason: Only observations through 2025-Q4 are authorized. Data for 2026-Q1..Q3 has been published by the generation date but is protected and was not used.

regional_sws_hunger.note: Context only; not forecast (4 eligible SWS quarters on disk).

meta.selection_rule: lowest Brier on the h=5 walk-forward evaluation set (protocol section 5)
meta.forecast_status: exploratory - ranking skill in a short back-test only
limitations: Forecasts relative food-price pressure (a component of the study's food-stress label), not measured food insecurity.
Exploratory: evaluated on 7 back-test quarters that were already examined in E19 at other leads.
Five-quarter horizon because 2026 data is not authorized; with 2026-Q3 data it would be two.
Every province had fewer than 5 news articles in 2025-Q4 (LIMITED_SIGNAL).
Unemployment is one regional series and cannot differentiate provinces.
No prediction intervals: 7 quarters cannot calibrate them.
Regular-milled rice price is one regional value in 16 of 24 quarters (all quarters since 2024-Q3), so it cannot differentiate provinces either.
meta.history_note: Quarters up to 2025-Q4 show the out-of-sample ONE-quarter-ahead back-test (E19); the 2027-Q1 forecast is FIVE quarters ahead (E20).
